ideas.idea: Put address, directions and parking on /visit so the page delivers what its description promises
ideas.why: The visit page has one line and no address, so the description's promise of directions is unmet.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD on the visit page
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix, and this pushes it as one.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite and Organization JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: Pushes JSON-LD that the deliberate choices say is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: List all forty-plus varieties to back up the claim
ideas.why: The varieties page names only two of the 'over forty' varieties, so there is little content to read or quote.

ideas.idea: Give each variety its own page and add them to the sitemap
ideas.why: Individual pages would give each variety its own URL that people and machines can find and link to.

ideas.idea: Add in-body links from the home page to Varieties and Visit, and link Herefordshire to directions
ideas.why: The nav already links all pages, so body links add only a small benefit.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap, or generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it matters little for a three-URL static sitemap.

ideas.idea: Expand the home page to say what is sold, where, and how to buy
ideas.why: The home page has two short lines and does not say what the orchard sells or how to buy.

ideas.idea: Make titles and descriptions more specific by naming the orchard and place, e.g. 'Visit Orchard, Herefordshire'
ideas.why: The titles are already adequate, and this is a minor tweak that would suit almost any site.
